stock.description: Operating a network of quick-service restaurants throughout the People's Republic of China, DPC Dash Ltd, together with its subsidiary entities, serves as the primary operator of numerous Domino's Pizza locations under that brand. The company's menu features a range of fast-food items, including pizzas, various chicken dishes, and beverages. Beyond its restaurant operations, DPC Dash Ltd is also involved in the production and sale of dough products, offers warehousing services, and engages in investment holding. This enterprise, which was formerly known as Dash Brands Ltd, was established in 2008 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
